title: Chained Soul
description: A lantern holding a rising soul-wisp hangs among broken chains, thorned roses, and ruined cathedral stone. This shin-length dark realism composition includes clean stencil art, a placement mockup, style and lore cards, premium pack art, and a reference board.
outline_standard: Clean black line art on white, prepared as a tattoo reference outline. Have a licensed tattoo artist review and adapt sizing and transfer setup before use.
